document_title: Tata Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS L2) & Telematics Service Manual
chapter: Chapter 2: Forward Camera & Millimeter Wave Radar Alignment
section: Section 2.2: Front Forward Camera (FFC) Static & Dynamic Calibration
content:
FAULT CODE: C1A12 - Forward Facing Camera Misalignment; DTC C1A15 - Camera Optical Blockage or Glare.
SYMPTOM: ADAS Malfunction warning lamp displayed; Lane Keep Assist (LKA) and Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) disabled.
CALIBRATION PREREQUISITES:
1. Vehicle parked on level workshop bay floor (tilt grade < 0.2 degrees).
2. Front windshield thoroughly cleaned, zero stone chips or optical distortion in front of camera lens.
3. Fuel tank filled to at least 90%; tire pressures set exactly to door jamb placard spec (33 psi cold).
STATIC CALIBRATION WORKFLOW:
Step 1: Mount calibration target board (Tata ADAS Target Pattern #TAT-TGT-01) at exactly 3.0 meters (3000 mm ± 10 mm) from the front bumper center badge.
Step 2: Adjust target board center height to 1250 mm from level ground.
Step 3: Ensure workshop ambient lighting is uniform between 400 lux and 800 lux (avoid fluorescent flicker directly above camera).
Step 4: Initiate FFC Static Learning in diagnostic software. Process takes 45 seconds; verify pitch angle is within ± 1.2 degrees and roll angle is within ± 0.8 degrees.
DYNAMIC CALIBRATION WORKFLOW:
Drive vehicle on well-marked multi-lane expressway between 65 km/h and 90 km/h for minimum 15 minutes until calibration status bar reaches 100%.

document_title: Tata Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS L2) & Telematics Service Manual
section: Section 3.1: Radar Bumper Alignment & Doppler Azimuth Angle Adjustment
content:
FAULT CODE: C1B01 - Radar Sensor Azimuth Angle Out of Tolerance; DTC U011D - Lost Communication with Front Distance Radar.
SYMPTOM: False Forward Collision Warning (FCW) alerts triggered by guardrails on highway curves.
DIAGNOSTIC WORKFLOW:
Step 1: Inspect lower front bumper grille bracket for mechanical impact deformation or bent clips.
Step 2: Mount optical laser level tool TAT-RAD-LASER to radar housing face. Direct laser beam to corner reflector target positioned 5 meters in front of vehicle centerline.
Step 3: Using 3.5 mm Allen hex key, turn horizontal azimuth adjustment screw until laser dot falls within the target center crosshair circle (± 0.5 degrees).
Step 4: Inspect 8-pin radar connector R-01 for CAN-FD bus termination resistance: Between CAN-High (Pin 3) and CAN-Low (Pin 4), resistance must measure 60 Ohms ± 4 Ohms.
TORQUE SPECIFICATION: Radar mounting bracket Torx T20 screws: 4.5 Nm ± 0.4 Nm.

document_title: Tata Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS L2) & Telematics Service Manual
chapter: Chapter 5: Telematics Control Unit (TCU) & iRA Connected Car Platform
section: Section 5.3: TCU e-SIM Provisioning & CAN Gateway Communication
content:
FAULT CODE: U0198 - Lost Communication with Telematics Control Module; DTC B125F - Telematics Internal e-SIM Authentication Failed.
SYMPTOM: Mobile app remote lock/unlock inoperative; SOS emergency call button red LED illuminated.
DIAGNOSTIC WORKFLOW:
Step 1: Check fuse F22 (10A) in interior cabin fuse block behind glove compartment.
Step 2: Inspect TCU internal backup battery (3.7V Li-ion pouch cell). If voltage is below 3.2V, replace internal cell (Part #TAT-TCU-BAT02).
Step 3: Verify GNSS / 4G LTE roof shark-fin antenna coaxial cables (Fakra connectors: Blue = GPS, Bordeaux = Cellular). Insertion loss must be < 1.5 dB.
Step 4: Run TCU Hard Reset routine: Hold SOS button and Wrench button simultaneously for 15 seconds until status LED flashes amber 3 times.
